block.field: Step Index AI hedge armed — Step Index 100, four ticks. The ensemble names the side on every readable tick and the Kelly stake sizes it; when the stake is large enough the opposite leg is bought at "ai hedge ratio" of it, so the pair keeps most of a measured edge while it caps the swing. Every entry is risk-checked at the pair's combined exposure before either order is sent.
AI is ready but the entry gate held it — the pair's combined exposure against the balance percentage, the loss limit or the profit target blocked this cycle.
AI session stop — the loss limit, the profit target or the balance rule was reached. Open contracts still settle; restart the bot to begin a new session.
